comments.content: This happened to us too. The fix was adding proper connection pooling. We were creating new connections for every request which added 200ms overhead.

Monorepo vs polyrepo debates are mostly about team structure, not code. If your teams are independent and rarely touch each other's code, polyrepo makes sense. If you have shared libraries and frequent cross-team collaboration, monorepo helps.
